2607.12058.title: AutoTrace: From Patches to Triggers via Agentic Interprocedural Exploration
2607.12058.paper_summary: Given a vulnerability-fixing commit, trigger localization asks which specific statement turns the vulnerable program state into a concrete unsafe operation. This question is harder than binary vulnerability detection because the answer demands interprocedural, causal reasoning: in a substantial fraction of real-world CVEs the triggering statement lies several call layers outside the patched function, beyond the reach of static rule sets and pattern-matching language models alike. We present AutoTrace, an agentic pipeline that localizes vulnerability triggers by exploring a code property graph layer by layer, with LLM agents deciding where to look next and deterministic admissibility gates deciding what evidence is required before a trigger can be reported. Agents never accept a trigger on their own authority; every reported trigger is backed by explicit evidence drawn from the graph, so the pipeline covers both intra- and interprocedural vulnerabilities without relying on ungrounded model judgment. On the full InterPVD benchmark, AutoTrace reaches 75.0% VulnHit and 80.8% FuncHit, surpassing the prior state of the art on the same corpus. Building on the same machinery, we construct SinkTrace-Bench, a dataset that exposes each vulnerability as a source-to-sink (S2S) causal chain from attacker-controlled input through propagation to the dangerous operation, drawn from matched vulnerable and patched program states. It comprises 1,542 verifier-confirmed, perfectly balanced vulnerable/safe samples whose label fidelity we audit against expert annotations. Benchmarking frontier LLMs on it, we find that even the strongest struggle to separate the matched pairs, exposing the causal-reasoning gap that trigger localization targets. Artifact available at https://github.com/Erroristotle/AutoTrace.
2607.12058.paper_summary_zh: 給定一個修補漏洞的提交，觸發本地化會詢問哪一個具體語句將易受攻擊的程序狀態轉變為具體的不安全操作。這個問題比二進制漏洞檢測更難，因為答案需要跨程序的因果推理：在相當一部分現實世界的CVE中，觸發語句位於修補函數的幾層調用之外，超出了靜態規則集和模式匹配語言模型的範疇。我們提出了AutoTrace，一個代理管道，通過逐層探索代碼屬性圖來定位漏洞觸發，LLM代理決定下一步的查找位置，而確定性可接受性閘則決定在報告觸發之前需要什麼證據。代理從不單獨接受觸發；每個報告的觸發都有明確的證據支持，這些證據來自圖形，因此該管道涵蓋了內部和跨程序的漏洞，而不依賴於無根據的模型判斷。在完整的InterPVD基準上，AutoTrace達到了75.0%的VulnHit和80.8%的FuncHit，超越了在相同語料庫上的先前最先進技術。在相同的機制基礎上，我們構建了SinkTrace-Bench，一個數據集，將每個漏洞暴露為從攻擊者控制的輸入通過傳播到危險操作的源到匯（S2S）因果鏈，這些鏈來自匹配的易受攻擊和修補的程序狀態。它包含1,542個經驗證者確認的、完美平衡的易受攻擊/安全樣本，我們對其標籤的準確性進行了專家註釋的審核。在對其進行基準測試的前沿LLM上，我們發現即使是最強的模型也難以區分匹配對，揭示了觸發本地化所針對的因果推理差距。文檔可在 https://github.com/Erroristotle/AutoTrace 獲得。
